descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S22 「从点 Link 到文字出现在病历上的时间，以及 25 个框的记事本加载」 Time from Link tap to text on the chart, and pad load with 25 boxes

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U2 Each box has 'Assign to patient', which opens a patient picker. Assigning appends the box's text verbatim to the end of that patient's encounter note and marks the box as assigned.（UAT TC-04；TFA-92582 AC 3；TFA-92582 steps 2-3）
  • U1 Quick Dictation opens from the Hospital home screen (patient list). The physician dictates or types into a box and adds a new box for the next patient, so one pad holds several boxes.（UAT TC-04；TFA-92582 step 1）

测试设计方法：性能（performance） — 量时间，看是不是在要求的秒数里。

Given QA Hosp Patel (415); 25 compartments already on the pad

When Open the pad, wait until all boxes show, type 'Bed 415, stable.' into the last one and tap Link, open Patel's Encounter tab

Then Time to a settled pad and time from tap to text on the chart are recorded per run

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：No UAT or ticket target (Q11): timings are reported as data for Daniela, not judged. Correctness of the placement is judged by S01/S02

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PERF · 性能计时；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（not-testable）

S22 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-04.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：PERF · 性能计时；辅助：PW · Playwright 脚本 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
